# Chart navigation

A nautical chart shows depths, hazards, buoys and lights. Plotting a course on the chart and checking position often keeps the boat in safe water. Allow for [[Tides and currents]] when you plot.

## Plotting a course

Draw the track between waypoints, measure the bearing with a plotter and correct from true to magnetic for the compass.

## Buoyage

Lateral marks show the sides of a channel; cardinal marks show where safe water lies relative to a hazard.
